title: Browser sign-ins
offline: This Mac needs to be online to view or import.
empty: No sites are signed in in ego lite yet. Import a cookie file exported from another computer or browser, and the assistant can open those sites as you.
privacy: Only sites and counts are listed, never cookie contents. An imported file is read in this page, and only the sites you check go through the hub straight to this Mac. The hub doesn't keep them, and the assistant can't see or export them.

import_note: These go into the default profile of ego lite on this Mac, so you'll be signed in when you browse in ego too. Clear them here when you no longer need them.
clear_all_title: Clear sign-ins for all sites in ego lite?
clear_all_body: All of ego lite's cookies on this Mac are deleted, and every site needs a new sign-in. That includes your own sign-ins in ego.
clear_site_body: This site is signed out in ego lite on this Mac. That includes your own sign-in in ego.
